newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ABS to discontinue monthly c/a deficit data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ABS to discontinue monthly c/a deficit data.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday it would discontinue the publication of monthly balance of payments and merchandise imports on balance of payments basis.
It said these would be replaced by two new monthly publications, international trade in goods and services and international merchandise imports.
The ABS said the next merchandise imports publication, due on February 19, would be the last, while Friday's December balance of payments was the last of that series.
It said February would be the first reference month for the new publication on international merchandise imports.
January would be the first reference month for the new publication, international trade in goods and services, which was expected to be released on March 3.

The ABS had conducted a review of the balance of payments publication due to concerns that the quality of the series, which is substantially reflected irregular factors and include extrapolated estimates, could not support the intense scrutiny that accompanied the publication each month.
